name: react-architecture-visualizer
description: Scan React projects and generate interactive architecture diagrams.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @rav/shared && npm run build -w @rav/audit && npm run build -w @rav/ui && npm run build -w @rav/parser
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rav/shared && npm run build -w @rav/audit && npm run build -w @rav/ui && npm run build -w @rav/parser && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rav/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rav/audit && npm run typecheck -w @rav/ui && npm run typecheck -w @rav/parser && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w vscode-extension
